description: 5 DAY DANGEROUS TREE NOTICE - Willow - very large limb unexpectedly broke away from the tree, this is now the second occasion on which a substantial limb has failed. In addition, the remaining major branch has sustained significant damage. Approximately half of the supporting section appears to have torn away, leaving a large, heavy limb extending over the public pavement. This footpath is heavily used throughout the day, including by school children walking to and from school. We are genuinely fearful that, should another branch fail, it could result in serious injury or even the loss of life.
decision_conditions:
The Local Planning Authority accepts that the recent branch failure and associated damage to the remaining limb constitutes a genuine safety concern requiring urgent attention. The Authority therefore grants permissions to the minimum works necessary to remove the damaged and failed sections of the tree and to make the retained tree safe.

This acceptance relates only to those works required to address the immediate risk identified within the notification. It does not constitute agreement to the removal of the entire tree, nor to any pruning beyond that necessary to make the tree safe. Any further works to the protected tree will require separate notification or consent from the Local Planning Authority as appropriate.
